name: British Thoroughfares and Numbers
description: Thoroughfares with each descriptor the parser splits off (reported in full, as Royal Mail writes them) and the abbreviations people type for them, streets with no descriptor (Kingsway, The Strand), a street called The and a descriptor, a Saint at the start, and building numbers with a letter, a range, a nought and a comma after them. Original cases written for this corpus from Royal Mail's addressing rules, described in our own words; nothing copied.
